# Game Idea

1: // Simple dodge game implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
12:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
13: 
14:   // Audio context and simple sound helpers
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   const playTone = (freq, duration = 0.1) => {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
20:     osc.type = 'sine';
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
25:     osc.start();
26:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
27:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
28:   };
29:   const playSpawn = () => playTone(300, 0.05);
30:   const playHit = () => playTone(100, 0.2);
31: 
32: 
33:   // Player configuration
34:   const player = {
35:     width: 50,
36:     height: 20,
37:     x: width / 2 - 25,
38:     y: height - 30,
39:     speed: 5,
40:     color: '#00f'
41:   };
42: 
43:   // Falling circles configuration
44:   const circles = [];
45:   const circleSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
46:   const circleRadius = 15;
47:   const circleSpeed = 2;
48: 
49:   // Game state
50:   let leftPressed = false;
51:   let rightPressed = false;
52:   let lastSpawn = 0;
53:   let startTime = null;
54:   const gameDuration = 60 * 1000; // 60 seconds
55:   let gameOver = false;
56: 
57:   // Input handling
58:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
59:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') leftPressed = true;
60:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') rightPressed = true;
61:   });
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
63:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') leftPressed = false;
64:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') rightPressed = false;
65:   });
66: 
67:   function spawnCircle() {
68:     const x = Math.random() * (width - circleRadius * 2) + circleRadius;
69:     const colors = ['#ff5252', '#ffb74d', '#ffeb3b', '#8bc34a', '#00bcd4', '#9575cd'];
70:     const color = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
71:     circles.push({ x, y: -circleRadius, radius: circleRadius, color });
72:     playSpawn();
73:   }
74: 
75:   function update(delta) {
76:     // Move player
77:     if (leftPressed) player.x = Math.max(0, player.x - player.speed);
78:     if (rightPressed) player.x = Math.min(width - player.width, player.x + player.speed);
79: 
80:     // Spawn circles
81:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > circleSpawnInterval) {
82:       spawnCircle();
83:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Update circles
87:     for (let i = circles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
88:       const c = circles[i];
89:       c.y += circleSpeed;
90:       // Remove off‑screen circles
91:       if (c.y - c.radius > height) circles.splice(i, 1);
92:     }
93: 
94:     // Collision detection
95:     for (const c of circles) {
96:       const closestX = Math.max(player.x, Math.min(c.x, player.x + player.width));
97:       const closestY = Math.max(player.y, Math.min(c.y, player.y + player.height));
98:       const dx = c.x - closestX;
99:       const dy = c.y - closestY;
100:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < c.radius * c.radius) {
101:         playHit();
102:         gameOver = true;
103:         break;
104:       }
105:     }
106: 
107:     // Timer check
108:     if (performance.now() - startTime >= gameDuration) gameOver = true;
109:   }
110: 
111:   function draw() {
112:     // Gradient background
113:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, height);
114:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // sky blue
115:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#f0f8ff'); // alice blue
116:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
117:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
118: 
119:     // Helper to draw rounded rectangle
120:     const drawRoundedRect = (x, y, w, h, r) => {
121:       ctx.beginPath();
122:       ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
123:       ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
124:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
125:       ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
126:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
127:       ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
128:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
129:       ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
130:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
131:       ctx.closePath();
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     };
134: 
135:     // Draw player with rounded corners
136:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
137:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height, 5);
138: 
139:     // Draw circles with radial gradient and varied colors
140:     for (const c of circles) {
141:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, c.radius * 0.2, c.x, c.y, c.radius);
142:       grad.addColorStop(0, c.color);
143:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
144:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
145:       ctx.beginPath();
146:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:       ctx.fill();
148:     }
149: 
150:     // Draw timer with subtle shadow
151:     const elapsed = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
153:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
154:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
155:     ctx.shadowOffsetX = 1;
156:     ctx.shadowOffsetY = 1;
157:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
158:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
159:   }
160: 
161:   function loop(timestamp) {
162:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
163:     const delta = timestamp - (lastFrame ?? timestamp);
164:     lastFrame = timestamp;
165:     if (!gameOver) {
166:       update(delta);
167:       draw();
168:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
169:     } else {
170:       // Game over screen
171:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
172:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
173:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
174:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
175:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
176:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
181: })();

(End of file - total 181 lines)
</content>
